lines.en: Why was the Ambassador particularly lucky?
lines.cn: 为什么这位大使特别幸运呢？

lines.en: When the Ambassador of Escalopia returned home for lunch, his wife got a shock.
lines.cn: 当埃斯卡洛皮亚大使回家吃午饭时，他的妻子感到非常震惊。

lines.en: He looked pale and his clothes were in a frightful state.
lines.cn: 他看起来脸色苍白，衣服也破烂不堪。

lines.en: 'What has happened?' she asked.
lines.cn: “发生了什么事？”她问道。

lines.en: 'How did your clothes get into such a mess?'
lines.cn: “你的衣服怎么会弄得这么乱糟糟的？”

lines.en: 'A fire extinguisher, my dear,' answered the Ambassador drily.
lines.cn: “是一具灭火器，亲爱的，”大使冷淡地回答道。

lines.en: 'University students set the Embassy on fire this morning.'
lines.cn: 今天早上，一些大学生放火烧毁了大使馆。

lines.en: 'Good heavens!' exclaimed his wife.
lines.cn: “我的天啊！”他的妻子惊呼道。

lines.en: 'And where were you at the time?'
lines.cn: “那你当时在哪里？”

lines.en: 'I was in my office as usual,' answered the Ambassador.
lines.cn: “我像往常一样在办公室里，”大使回答道。

lines.en: 'The fire broke out in the basement.
lines.cn: 火灾发生在地下室。

lines.en: I went down immediately, of course, and that fool, Horst,
lines.cn: 我立刻就下去了，当然了；还有那个傻瓜，霍斯特……

lines.en: aimed a fire extinguisher at me.
lines.cn: 有人用灭火器朝我射来。

lines.en: He thought I was on fire.
lines.cn: 他以为我着火了。

lines.en: I must definitely get that fellow posted.'
lines.cn: 我一定要把那个人的信息发布出去。

lines.en: The Ambassador's wife went on asking questions,
lines.cn: 大使的妻子不停地提问。

lines.en: when she suddenly noticed a big hole in her husband's hat.
lines.cn: 突然，她发现丈夫的帽子上有一个大洞。

lines.en: 'And how can you explain that?' she asked.
lines.cn: “那你又该如何解释这件事呢？”她问道。

lines.en: 'Oh, that,' said the Ambassador.
lines.cn: “哦，那个……”大使说道。

lines.en: 'Someone fired a shot through my office window.
lines.cn: 有人从我的办公室窗户向外开了一枪。

lines.en: Accurate, don't you think?
lines.cn: “非常准确，不是吗？”

lines.en: Fortunately, I wasn't wearing it at the time.
lines.cn: 幸运的是，当时我并没有戴着它。

lines.en: If I had been, I would not have been able to get home for lunch.'
lines.cn: 如果我当时在（某个地方），我就无法回家吃午饭了。
